description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. No 11 of 2021 " PORT CITY DUTY FREE (PVT) LTD "
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It specifies legal designations, exemptions, and incentives for a business entity under established regulations. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
